snippet.title: Croak - Official Release Window Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Check out platforming gameplay and boss fights in this new trailer for Croak, an upcoming hand-drawn 2D precision platformer game. Croak will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, day one with Game Pass, and supports Xbox Play Anywhere in March 2027.

Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in Croak. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Hungry for a little competition? Take on your friends and the fastest frogs in the world on the online speedrunning leaderboard.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
